title: Guided Canary Concierge: Minimalist Contextual Rollback Assistant
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a compact, contextual rollback assistant that surfaces during canary/A-B rollouts as a lightweight overlay (the 'Canary Concierge'). Aim is to reduce cognitive load for engineers and PMs by providing stepwise rollback guidance, a confidence band based on telemetry, and a one-click non-destructive snapshot and revert flow. The experience should be minimal (small footprint on the rollout timeline), emphasize explainability (why we suggest rollback), and integrate with the existing rollout timeline and metrics panels without duplicating UI.
acceptance_criteria: Concierge overlay prototype in Figma covering: initial suggestion state, expanded reasoning view, one-click snapshot + soft-revert, and emergency full-revert flows
Clear mapping of telemetry signals used for suggestions (latency p50/p95, error-rate, model-quality regression) and hover-to-explain for each metric
Non-blocking confirmation flows that allow manual override and require explicit acknowledgment for destructive reverts
Design tokens and spacing consistent with Console styles; overlay scales down to 1200px width and mobile breakpoint for small tablet use
Handoff-ready artifact with frame-by-frame annotations, component spec, and interaction notes for engineers
Design review feedback addressed and a live prototype link shared with PM and Eng for usability testing
decisions: Use an overlay anchored to the timeline scrubber instead of a full-width banner to keep context and avoid pushing metrics off screen
Suggestion engine will surface a 'confidence band' (low/medium/high) instead of raw p-values to keep language accessible to PMs and SREs
Implement a two-step soft-revert: 1) create immutable snapshot of traffic routing + model pin, 2) apply traffic reallocation with staged rollback option
Emergency full-revert requires 2-step confirmation with reason capture and optional incident link
Do not automatically trigger reverts; Concierge only recommends and provides fast-execute controls to on-call engineers
